scope: Newest A–E paired batches only, with R1 empty, R2 occupied, R3 empty. Retrospective, no new acquisition or point-specific calibration. Do not use point coordinates, angle sign tuning, packet amplitude, or closeness to truth at prediction time.
data: Use the previous verified decoder, clock, [READY+3, READY+21) ms and 1-degree [-90,90] grid. Per station set M=12*floor(min eligible count across all six states, all runs and quarters /12). Every configuration uses exactly M distinct packets per quarter (4M per run). Roles ordered P,S,L1,L2,H1,H2. From each physical state and quarter choose M time-spread packet ordinals; role j gets ordinals j::6. G2-only uses G2 for all six disjoint roles. Twelve uses [G2,G3,C1,C2,G4,G1]. Short-only hardware ablation uses [G2,G3,G2,G2,G4,G1]. Proposal role uses precisely the same actual G2 packets in all arms. Also report the full-budget G2 single-state global peak separately. No role has a duplicate packet within the same arm/run.
estimators: Primary: inherited background-subspace-projected MUSIC (same R1-only fitting, tone and projection availability rules). Secondary existing positive-rank-one change MUSIC computed with the identical packet and branch rules; do not switch per point. Plane-wave physical steering, no synthetic CPA or coherent aperture.
proposals: Role P only supplies up to two interior or boundary local minima of its full angular MUSIC cost; <=6 dB below the strongest and >=20 deg apart. Full-grid cost uses no truth. Original full-grid extrema include physical grid endpoints but do not treat an internal mask edge as a local minimum. Keep the shortlist angles unchanged when validating with other states. Preserve total local count and all eligible peaks, including those truncated beyond two.
comparisons: For each retained angle, take the minimal MUSIC cost within +/-9 deg; the two neighbourhoods do not overlap. With two entries, each long role compares the two via 10log10(cost_other/cost_candidate). A directional vote needs at least 1 dB on the full spectrum, same preference in both half bands and >=3/4 quarter spectra. Missing cost of a competing direction is not a vote. 0 and 3 dB are declared sensitivities, not fitted thresholds; tie never wins. Descriptive combined-long preference is the mean of the two full-band dB margins, even if the roles disagree. It never overrides refusal.
release: Require a non-edge seed (<87 deg in absolute value), stable local peak on P (within 9 deg and 6 dB of each view maximum, full/both halves/>=3 quarters); both long roles must vote for it. At least one disjoint corroboration pair, L1 and H1 (C1+G4) or L2 and H2 (C2+G1), must both have stable local peaks near it. Both long votes must agree; G3/S must be measurable and may veto a stable vote for the other branch. With one seed there is no disambiguation; require both long roles to have stable local support. In twelve-channel data the held G is physically disjoint from P and its own long checker; C1/C2 share elements 6/8 and are not independent replicates.
controls: Use the same R1 background for R2 and the reserved empty R3. Qualify matching peaks on R3; veto a stable nearby short-plus-long-plus-held triple, require at least one such R3 triple evaluable on full + both bands + >=3 quarters for a fully checked release. Require common-scale positive beam-contrast R2/R3 >1. Repeat R2 with R3 background as sensitivity; require a near full-band P local peak and the same full-band long preferences (threshold applies when two). Report any missing controls and all rejected branches. Two original candidates without a unique supported selection remain unresolved alternatives, not two human paths. Single unsupported candidate is explicitly unconfirmed; zero available is a rejection.
metrics: Score only after freezing candidates, votes and releases. For a fair difference use the same RX-centre truth for both arms; G2 local-centre values also reported separately. Report full-budget G2 and both arms' blind tentative preferences, selected singles, both candidates' errors, coverage, false branch elimination, and nearest-branch diagnostic only as a shortlist ceiling, never fused MAE. Include all five sites. Within-visit diagnostic success is not independent human-path validation. No separate calibration set for the dB margin.
